SECTION_DESC: Choose a saved playlist. A copy with randomly ordered tracks is created and ' shuffle' is added to its name. Running it again re-shuffles the copy. Every track plays once per pass and Previous works normally. Tip: use the shuffled copy together with an autostart plugin that resumes the queue after a restart.
CREATE_BTN_DESC: The original playlist is not changed
ERR_EMPTY: The playlist is empty or unreadable
ERR_WRITE: Could not save the new playlist
